scope: UMich 2021 Streaming/Tread (50 recordings) sagittal angles, joint kinetics, segment estimates and force plates. Run, Stair, Wtr and transfers are out of scope. The policy governs columns; it does not approve the dataset.

source_data.note: Not rehashed (bulk read forbidden). Size and mtime re-checked against the conversion receipt before and after the probe.

author_and_model_evidence.source: Reznick et al. 2021, Sci Data, doi:10.1038/s41597-021-01057-9 (bound paper.xml), Methods 'Motion capture'
author_and_model_evidence.quote: In our dataset, each joint has a consistent sign convention for its angles and moments, where ankle dorsiflexion, knee flexion, and hip flexion are defined in the positive directions.
author_and_model_evidence.supports: Sagittal sign of hip/knee/ankle angles and moments.

author_and_model_evidence.quote: We utilized Vicon's proprietary Dynamic Plug-in Gait Model to calculate joint angles ... In trials using the treadmill forceplates, Plug-in Gait was also used to approximate joint forces, moments, and powers.
author_and_model_evidence.supports: Model identity: Plug-in Gait (Nexus 2). Exact Nexus version, reaction frame and static options not stated.

(unit: W/kg) Corrected to reflect the internal moment of the joint; Where applicable, Columns 1, 2, 3 = Dimension x,y,z Paper Table 2: jointPower 'results from the multiplication of jointMoment and the estimated joint velocity.'

author_and_model_evidence.source: R01 Dataset README.pdf p.3; paper.xml Table 2
author_and_model_evidence.quote: README: forceplates 'weight normalized ... directions follow the local force plate frame ... Force - (x (side to side), y (propulsive/braking), z (normal to ground)) (unit: N/kg) ... CoP (unit: m)'. Paper Table 2: 'forceplates Force: (N) Moment: (N.m) COP: (m) 1000 Hz ... x/y/z of variable in global space'; Methods: 'downsampled to 100 Hz for publication'.

The paper is internally inconsistent on rate (Methods: downsampled to 100 Hz; Table 2: Streaming forceplates 1000 Hz) and states N, metres, global space. The probe matches neither on units (P5).

author_and_model_evidence.quote: Pelvic tilt ... A positive value (up) corresponds to the normal situation in which the PSIS is higher than the ASIS. / Hip flexion ... A positive (Flexion) angle value corresponds to the situation in which the knee is in front of the body. / Knee ... a positive angle corresponds to a flexed knee. / Ankle dorsi/plantar flexion ... A positive number corresponds to dorsiflexion.

author_and_model_evidence.source: Vicon Nexus 2.16 'Plug-in Gait output specification' https://vicon-help.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Nexus216/pages/11605972 (retrieved 2026-10-27; page html sha256 2a6f18f1fd52d849ddd090d430b1360ca0f5597cc4c2d209ac8638f9df5ad7f8, not stored in repo)
author_and_model_evidence.quote: Joint kinematic table: 1st component = Tilt (pelvis), Flexion (hip, knee, ankle) for both sides; 2nd/3rd components have side-specific signs (e.g. Left Hip Adduction (-X), Right Hip Adduction (X)). 'For the moments ... the order they are stored in the .c3d file matches the rotation order'; moment table 1st component axis: hip -Y, knee Y, ankle Y (proximal and distal). 'Moments - N.mm/kg' as Nexus displays; 'the reaction frame can be specified ... proximal, distal, or in the global frame'; 'Due to the differing alignment of the foot and tibia segment co-ordinate systems, the components of the ankle moment differ depending on whether they are represented in the proximal, distal or global co-ordinate systems.'
author_and_model_evidence.supports: Component 1 is the flexion angle/moment for every joint and side. Ankle 2nd/3rd moment components depend on an unstated reaction frame. Nexus native moment unit differs from the curated N*m/kg (do not rescale).

author_and_model_evidence.source: LocoHub target convention: git 330789e docs/reference/index.md 'Coordinate & Sign Conventions' (removed from current docs/reference/index.md); contributor_tools/common/CLAUDE.md OpenSim moment table
author_and_model_evidence.quote: Hip flexion (+): thigh forward; Knee flexion (+): heel toward buttocks; Ankle dorsiflexion (+): toes up; Pelvis sagittal (+): anterior tilt. GRF anterior positive = propulsion; lateral positive = medial. OpenSim helper: hip flexion +, knee negated to flexion +, ankle dorsiflexion + for inverse-dynamics (internal) moments.
author_and_model_evidence.supports: Target signs for angles. Internal-versus-external for *_flexion_moment_* and thigh/shank segment signs are not stated in the current researcher reference (open question Q7).

probe.resources: One trial at a time, few channels, RLIMIT_AS 1 GiB, nice 19 / ionice idle; MemAvailable about 13 GiB before each run.

findings.P1_pelvis_sign: Source pelvis component 1 minus marker pelvic tilt (PSIS above ASIS positive): median within 0.1 deg in all 5 author trials and within 0.04 deg in the verifier's 5 (seed 4242). 95th percentile absolute difference is a sample range: 0.4-0.9 deg here, 0.2-3.2 deg across both samples (3.15 deg in verifier AB06/d10, marker glitch frames). R and L PelvisAngles component 1 identical (max difference 0) in all 10 trials; components 2 and 3 differ by side as Vicon documents.
findings.P2_thigh_shank_recipe: Against trochanter-to-knee and knee-to-ankle marker vectors, author hip - pelvis (and hip - pelvis - knee) is closer than producer pelvis + hip in 8 of 8 random legs here, 10 of 10 with the lead, and 10 of 10 in the verifier sample. Author-recipe median thigh gap, sample range across both samples: -7.7 to +5.0 deg (trochanter is not the hip centre; the verifier used lateral knee markers). Shank: -4.1 to +3.1 deg. Producer: +9.1 to +60 deg here, +14.6 to +54 deg verifier, about twice the pelvic tilt.
findings.P3_moment_signs: Ankle moment component 1 reaches -1.15 to -1.90 N*m/kg (1st percentile) in every leg here, 99th percentile at most +0.21; the verifier found own-plate stance means -0.68 to -0.82 in 10 of 10 legs. A plantarflexor stance moment is negative, as expected for an internal moment with dorsiflexion positive. Magnitudes match N*m/kg, not N*mm/kg. Hip and knee moment signs have no independent physical check; they rest on E1 and E8.
findings.P4_power_sign: Power component 1 against moment component 1 x d(angle component 1)/dt: correlation -0.979 to -1.000 in every joint/side across both samples (60 of 60). Least-squares slope, sample range across both samples: -0.71 to -1.02 (-0.93 to -1.02 here). So source power has the opposite sign of internal-moment x joint velocity, approximately equal in magnitude. Paper Fig. 3 says positive = generation and Table 2 defines power as moment x velocity. Conflict; cause unknown.
findings.P5_force_plates: Force plate arrays have exactly 10x the joint-angle frames (1000 Hz), matching the README and the paper's Table 2 but not the paper's Methods sentence 'downsampled to 100 Hz for publication'. Vertical component reaches -807 to -1095 at the 1st percentile (verifier -786 to -976): newtons, negative under load, not N/kg. CoP x/y span hundreds (e.g. -632 to 447): millimetres, not metres; CoP z identically 0. The verifier found CoP offset from the foot markers, with x sign flipping between incline and decline, which is consistent with a local plate frame rather than the marker global frame. Walking direction is +Y in incline/level trials and -Y in decline trials (AB08/d10, AB10/d5 here; AB01/d5, AB06/d10 verifier, by three marker cues). A fixed y-to-anterior mapping is therefore invalid across trials.
findings.P6_ankle_anomalies: AB07/i10 right AnkleAngles: one contiguous run, frames 11712-17134 (1-based) of 17756, identical at |component 1| screens of 45, 60 and 90 deg (34 right strides touched), with components 2/3 near +174 to +179 and +156 to +177 deg; left leg normal. The pattern is consistent with, but not proof of, an alternate Euler solution. AB08/i0 left: the boundary is screen-dependent. At 45 deg it is 9 frames (13891-13899), at 60 deg 8 frames (13892-13899), at 90 deg 2 frames (13896-13897). The strides touched also change: 13770-13899 and 13899-14028 at 45/60 deg, only the first at 90 deg. No screen is justified by source evidence, so none is adopted; the screens are reported only. No offset is applied anywhere.
findings.lead_AB02_i5: Right hip component 1 p1-p99 3.4 to 57.4 deg, pelvis tilt mean 18.8 deg. Plug-in Gait hip flexion is relative to the anteriorly tilted pelvis, so it rarely reaches extension; marker thigh angle does reach -20 deg. This supports hip - pelvis for thigh and argues against reading the hip range as a sign error.

probe.limits: Marker vectors test signs and recipes, not model calibration or 3D frames. Author sample: 4 random recordings plus the lead and 2 named anomaly recordings. The verifier added 5 disjoint random recordings, for 10 of 50 in total. Bounds are reported as sample ranges, not population limits. The power, force-plate and ankle findings are observations, not adopted corrections.

agent_actions_logged: Withhold the current pelvis + hip thigh and shank values from any canonical column: they contradict the author recipe and marker geometry by about twice the pelvic tilt. Not a José decision because no option keeps them; producer change belongs to UM21-T02/T03.
Keep power, joint force, force plate and non-sagittal fields source-only (conservative default).
correspondence_questions: Q1 Which Nexus and Plug-in Gait version, moment reaction frame, and static options (foot flat, plantarflexion offset, tibial torsion) were used per participant? Can VSK or session files be shared?
Q2 Were jointPowers computed from the external moment or negated after export? Source power equals minus (internal moment x joint angular velocity) in every sampled trial.

Q3 Force plates in Streaming hold newtons and millimetres at 1000 Hz with vertical force negative under load; README says N/kg, metres and local plate frame; paper says N, metres, global, 100 Hz. Which is correct, and is Force the load on the plate?

Q4 Why does AB07 incline-10 right ankle switch to about -170 deg (components 2 and 3 near 180 deg) from frame 11712 to 17134, and what is the 8-frame AB08 level left excursion? Alternate Euler solution, marker swap, or reprocessing gap?
Q5 Which pelvis side feeds Normalized PelvisAngles (UM21-C02)? Streaming R and L tilt are identical in sampled trials.
Q6 Did decline trials face the opposite lab direction (walking direction -Y in AB08/d10 and AB10/d5)?
Q7 (internal, LocoHub) The current researcher reference no longer states joint-moment internal/external or segment-angle signs; it should before any moment or segment column is released as canonical.
limitations: No scientific approval; field statuses are a proposal until both decisions are answered and a second agent verifies.
